metadata.name: Serpent Gorge
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A jungle river canyon between an expedition camp and a stepped temple. Cross by the rope bridge (mind the rotten planks), the drawbridge (either winch shuts both gates and raises the bridge) or the river under the falls. Inside the temple: spike floors, serpent heads and a falling stone guard the idol; lift it and the room seals, leaving only the rotten floor down into the crypt. A cracked wall hides the treasure chamber.

do.text: Chains rattle: the gates slam shut and the drawbridge rises!
Chains rattle: the drawbridge comes down and the gates swing open.
Chains rattle: the gates slam shut and the drawbridge rises!
Chains rattle: the drawbridge comes down and the gates swing open.
The temple seals itself! Get out through the rotten floor in the corner!
Stone grinds: the idol room opens again.
